- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16377, 16388, 18585, 18621, 18801, 20918, 20928, 26596, 26606, 27663, 27685 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The jq programs are passed as two separate arguments instead of one concatenated string.
  WHY: jq treats the second argument as an input file name, and the `|| echo '0'` fallback then makes the active-run guard report zero active runs, which disables the guard. The source stated no severity; high is inferred from that impact. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this as a false positive: `"${zq_def}"'program'` is one concatenated bash word, and tests/test_zombie_queued_guard_contract.py::test_guard_jq_programs_compile_with_the_shared_definitions compiles these programs.

  WHY: jq cannot parse the program, so autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer fails and wrongly reports no in-flight peer runs. The source stated no severity; high is inferred. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this as a false positive (adjacent-quoted concatenation).

  WHY: The merge train guard fails to detect active runs, so conflicting PRs may be released while still under review. The source stated no severity; high is inferred. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this as a false positive.

  WHY: The active-run listing becomes incorrect, which may allow worktree registry conflicts. The source stated no severity; high is inferred. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dispute this as a false positive. This is a different root cause from the inert-filter finding below, so the two are not merged.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1366, 1399 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The jq programs are passed as two separate arguments.
  WHY: The stable gate wrongly reports zero active Plan runs, which allows concurrent Plan runs. The source stated no severity; high is inferred. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 dispute this as a false positive.
- scripts/worktree_registry.sh:252-265 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wedged-queued filter in `_worktree_registry_load_active_run_ids` never takes effect at runtime. Its helper functions (`zombie_queued_cutoff_epoch`, `zombie_queued_jq_def`, `zombie_queued_log_ignored`) live in scripts/gh_helpers.sh, which this script never sources, and the script always runs as a separate `bash scripts/worktree_registry.sh ...` process. So the `declare -F` guards at :257/:262 fail, and `zq_def` stays at the no-op `def is_wedged_queued($cutoff): false;`.
  WHY: `worktree_registry.sh gc` treats a worktree as owned by an active run when its owner_run_id is in the list (:519) and refuses to reap it (:523). A wedged queued run therefore keeps its worktree forever and no `ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED ... guard=worktree_registry_active_runs` line is written. The contract test at tests/test_zombie_queued_guard_contract.py:39 only greps source text, so it still passes. Severity MAJOR maps to high. Minimal fix: source gh_helpers.sh from `${_WORKTREE_REGISTRY_SCRIPT_DIR}` next to the emit_event.sh source (:13-16).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Each ignored run produces one searchable log line," at most once per run per guard per process (issue #9473 Goals), at the site ".github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: the plan-run in-flight checks near `:1283` / `:1309`".
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, the stable-gate Plan-run pagination loop (ACTIVE_WALK loop, lines 1389-1408) and the PLAN_ZQ_LOGGED latch
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The logger runs only for the page-1 payload PLAN_RUNS_JSON (.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1366-1373) inside `if [ -z "${PLAN_ZQ_LOGGED:-}" ]` (lines 1362-1372), and that latch turns off after the first emission (:1371). The later-page filter at :1401-1402 applies `select(is_wedged_queued($zq_cutoff) | not)` to ACTIVE_WALK_PAGE_COUNT but never calls `zombie_queued_log_ignored`. A wedged run ignored on page 2+ therefore gets no ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED line, while the active-run count itself stays correct. Reported severities were MAJOR (gemini) and NIT (minimax, luna, glm). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not re-raise this gap: it affects logging only and was accepted as won't-fix earlier.
- requirement: "At minimum: … `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py`: `:2652`, `:4984`, `:9511`" apply the wedged-queued filter (issue #9473 Implementation Steps).
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, the queued-run acceptance checks now at :2681, :5102 and :9630 (`verify_engine_reporter_run`, `verify_run_provenance`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff does not modify scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, and the file has no `is_wedged_queued` or `ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` reference. The sites still accept a queued run of any age, for example :2681 `run.get("status") not in ("queued", "in_progress")`, and the :5102 and :9630 pending-status checks. The exclusion is documented in agents.d/9473-ignore-wedged-queued-runs.md and locked by tests/test_zombie_queued_guard_contract.py::test_documented_exclusions_stay_unchanged. Reported severities were MAJOR (gemini, luna) and NIT (minimax, glm). minimax and glm note that these are report-provenance checks outside the issue's scope sentence ("guards that skip, wait or suppress dispatch because a run is queued"). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not re-raise this gap (TASK_GAP_DEFERRED in earlier rounds).
- requirement: "Existing suites (`tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py`, `tests/test_unblock_scan.py`, and others) still pass."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py and the associated implementation or test setup
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The acceptance table in the PR description marks tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py unmet, and its pre-push gate lists that suite among the failures caused by this change, so the required passing result is not established. Severity MAJOR.
